data.title: 神尾观铃 · 向日葵坡道的夏之招手
data.description: 通往海滨小镇的向日葵斜坡石阶上，两旁盛开着一人高的金黄花朵。观铃身穿名作经典夏日高腰水手制服，扶着草帽向走上坡道的你用力挥手，笑容澄澈动人。
data.location: sunlit cobblestone slope flanked by tall blooming sunflowers leading to sea
data.action: standing midway up hill waving enthusiastically with one hand, holding straw hat with the other, beaming smile
data.lighting: 坡道上方倾泻而下的明澈阳光
data.promptProse: Misuzu waves energetically from a sunflower-lined coastal slope holding her straw hat, greeting the viewer with an open-hearted smile.
data.animaCaption: Golden sunflower petals gleam in the bright morning sunlight as she waves excitedly.
